test_net: test a video classification model on AVA, EPIC-Kitchens, or Charades datasets
test_one_crop: test one crop of a video model using Caffe2 workspace and configurable test parameters
run_test_cli: run the test_net CLI with a config file and optional override arguments
get_test_name: generate a test output filename based on dataset, scale, flip, shift, and score threshold
build_model_builder: build a video model via ModelBuilder for inference with optional LFB feature loading
